INSERT INTO experiences (lang, slug, title, subtitle, headline, description, `includes`, price, priceLabel, duration, ctaText, seoText, imageUrl, isActive, sortOrder) VALUES (
  'en',
  'wald-auszeit',
  'Forest Retreat Bad Essen',
  'A weekend between forest, warmth and silence',
  'Arrive. Let go. Recharge.',
  'Some places you feel before you even enter them. The Waldhotel Bad Essen is one of those places. Nestled in the nature of the Wiehengebirge, surrounded by ancient trees and the tranquillity of a place that has welcomed guests for over a hundred years.\n\nThe Forest Retreat is our arrangement for anyone who wants to leave everyday life behind for a weekend. On Friday, your retreat begins with a visit to our forest sauna – bio sauna, Finnish sauna and outdoor sauna await you. On Saturday morning, a generous breakfast is served before the day is yours: hiking on the Wittekindsweg trail, a stroll through the historic old town, or simply enjoying the silence. On Sunday, you breakfast at your leisure and take advantage of the late check-out to let the final morning end without haste.\n\nTwo nights, two breakfasts, a sauna evening and a late farewell – that is all it takes for a weekend that stays with you.',
  '["2 nights in a double room","Breakfast for 2 on both mornings","Forest sauna for 2 on Friday","Late check-out on Sunday included"]',
  'from €295.00',
  'per arrangement for 2 persons',
  'Friday – Sunday',
  'Enquire about Forest Retreat',
  'Looking for a weekend trip to Bad Essen that combines relaxation and nature? The Forest Retreat at the Waldhotel Bad Essen offers you a short break in the countryside – with sauna, breakfast and the peace of the Wiehengebirge. Our hotel with sauna is located right at the edge of the forest and is the ideal starting point for hikes, deceleration and quality time together.',
  '',
  1,
  1
);
